company.name: Oddpool
company.shortDescription: Oddpool is a software company that develops prediction market analytics platform for investors and traders.
company.description: Oddpool is the all-in-one analytics platform for prediction markets, aggregating live data across venues to reveal real-time odds, market spreads, arbitrage opportunities, and actionable insights. Traders and analysts use Oddpool’s interactive dashboards to compare markets side-by-side, track volatility, and understand how consensus shifts across events. Oddpool brings structure, clarity, and speed to an ecosystem of fragmented prediction markets.
